_comment: Template for state/config.json. Copy this file to ../state/config.json and fill it in during first-run enrollment (see SKILL.md). This file holds only acos-email-sort's own operational settings — folders, thresholds, delegate keywords. Identity/org-chart data (VIP list, signoff, partner vendors, protected contacts) now lives in the shared acos-aboutme skill; the fields below with the same names are a local fallback only, used when acos-aboutme isn't installed or a given list is empty there.
signature_first_name_note: Local fallback only — superseded by acos-aboutme's owner.signoff whenever that profile exists and has one set.
vip_senders_note: Local fallback only — superseded by acos-aboutme's vip_senders whenever that profile exists and is non-empty.
partner_vendors_note: Local fallback only — superseded by acos-aboutme's partner_vendors whenever that profile exists and is non-empty. A message from one of these domains is never auto-declined, even if it matches a template.
protected_senders_note: Local fallback only — superseded by acos-aboutme's protected_senders whenever that profile exists and is non-empty. A message from one of these addresses is never auto-declined, even if it matches a template.
delegate_keywords_placeholder_note: PLACEHOLDER — Trevor has not yet specified the real criteria for delegate-worthy mail. These are a reasonable starting guess (scheduling/logistics, travel coordination, expense-receipt chasing) and must be confirmed or replaced before this list is trusted.
folder_naming_note: The live mailbox's fourth folder is named '4_autorespond' (not '4_autoresponse' as first drafted in the build spec) — this config reflects what actually exists. Rename either side if you want them to match; the skill works fine with either as long as this config's folder_names.autorespond value matches the real folder.
